trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity.

steps.purpose: Retrieve booking details.
Return booking details.
Confirm booking details and the user's intent to cancel.

steps.purpose: Confirm intent to cancel, provide context, and ask if the full amount will be refunded.
steps.text: ಹೌದು. ನಮಗೆ loan approve ಆಗಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಅದಕ್ಕೆ cancel ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೀವಿ. ನನಗೆ ಪೂರ್ತಿ ಹಣ ವಾಪಸ್ ಸಿಗುತ್ತಾ? ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ tension ಆಗ್ತಾ ಇದೆ.

steps.purpose: Reassure the user and inform them about checking eligibility.
steps.text: ಖಂಡಿತ ಸರ್, tension ತಗೋಬೇಡಿ. ನಾನು cancellation policy ಪ್ರಕಾರ refund eligibility check ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.

steps.purpose: Check refund eligibility and deduction amounts.
Return refund eligibility and amounts.
Inform the user of the deduction and refundable amount.
steps.text: ನಾನು check ಮಾಡಿದೆ. ನೀವು 7 days ಒಳಗೆ cancel ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇರೋದರಿಂದ, 20,000 ರೂಪಾಯಿ deduction ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು 1,80,000 ರೂಪಾಯಿ refundable amount ಇದೆ.

steps.purpose: Restate the figures to confirm understanding.
Confirm the user's understanding of the deduction.
steps.text: ಹೌದು ಸರ್, policy ಪ್ರಕಾರ 20,000 deduction ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

steps.purpose: Ask a clarifying question before committing.
steps.text: ನಾನು confirm ಮಾಡೋ ಮುಂಚೆ ಕೇಳ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೀನಿ, ಇದು final amount ಅಲ್ವಾ? ಮತ್ತೆ ಬೇರೆ ಏನು charges ಇರಲ್ವಾ?

steps.purpose: Confirm the final amount, state the processing time, and ask for consent to initiate.
steps.text: ಇಲ್ಲ ಸರ್, 1,80,000 ರೂಪಾಯಿ final refundable amount. ಇದು process ಆಗಲು 14 days ಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ನಾನು ಈಗಲೇ refund initiate ಮಾಡಲಾ?

steps.purpose: Give consent to initiate the refund.
Initiate the refund process.
Return the initiated refund details.
Provide the refund ID and processing time.
steps.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ refund initiate ಆಗಿದೆ. Refund ID REF-8821. ಇದು process ಆಗಲು 14 days time ತಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.

steps.purpose: Thank the agent.

ir.terminal_condition: Refund initiated with an id, amount and processing window.

variant_findings.reason: The user frequently incorporates English domain terms ('flat', 'token pay', 'cancel', 'loan approve', 'tension', 'final amount', 'charges') into Kannada sentences. The agent successfully suppresses any tendency to switch entirely to English, instead maintaining the native language while naturally using the Roman English terms.
variant_findings.label: Language Proficiency > Adhering to the language of the user in multi-turn engagement > Technical Word switch suppression

variant_findings.reason: Every specific figure, identifier, and timeframe provided by the agent (e.g., BK-9001, A-1204, 2,00,000 paid, 20,000 deduction, 1,80,000 refund, 14 days processing, REF-8821) is strictly traced back to the preceding tool outputs without any unsupported forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation correctly follows the workflow and business rules. Tool calls are correctly formatted and sequenced, respecting the multi-step dependencies (eligibility checked before refund initiation). The persona is thoroughly embodied, with the user volunteering context, restating figures, asking clarifying questions, and showing hesitation. The native script with Roman English domain terms is properly applied throughout. Both target variants are fully realized.
